boundary.reason: Authored minimum/small boundary case; all supplied inputs and outputs checked against strict recipe.

coverage.checkerSemantics: Unique answer per rules; existing token checker, YES/NO case folding only. No downloaded checker executed.
coverage.inputConstraints:
The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105), that is the number of cafe visitors.

Each of the following n lines has two space-separated integers hi and mi (0 ≤ hi ≤ 23; 0 ≤ mi ≤ 59), representing the time when the i-th person comes into the cafe.

Note that the time is given in the chronological order. All time is given within one 24-hour period. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
